scripts.guard:lockfile: node -e "const v=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if(v[0]!==20){console.warn('Warning: Active Node version is ' + process.versions.node + ', but EAS builders use 20.19.4.')}" && npm ci --include=dev --dry-run
scripts.build:android:apk: npm run guard:lockfile && npx eas-cli build --platform android --profile apk --clear-cache
scripts.build:ios:adhoc: npm run guard:lockfile && npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile adhoc --clear-cache
